method.riskMatch: Constant full-sample volatility scaling; descriptive, not a feasible ex-ante allocation
method.bootstrap: Centered circular fixed-length blocks, common dates across all 39 sizes, fixed observed standard deviations, one-sided empirical max-statistic; percentile mean intervals conditional on observed risk scales
method.costs: Additional one-way bps charged on twice the declared daily replacement fraction times the constant invested exposure; fixed allocated daily dollars charged against beginning capital. Initial capital 10000 USD. Benchmark charged zero additional cost. Turnover and actual costs unobserved.
method.selectionScope: Only the 39 published sizes; excludes unreported models, prompts, portfolio weights and research choices

frozenProtocol.atrWarmup: First 14 available daily observations from November 2025 seed the same Wilder recurrence; every decision uses the prior stored value
frozenProtocol.signalAndFillRules: Exactly the September discovery algorithm; no parameter search or outcome-selected symbols. Strictly prior daily Wilder ATR, first regular-session bar opening proxy, next eligible bar-open fills, entry-only negative five-minute pullback, gap/intrabar stops and no delayed protective exits.
frozenProtocol.coverageGate: Require all expected regular-session bars; no imputation or dropping gapped sessions
frozenProtocol.SPYRole: Paper benchmark diagnostic; SPY is excluded from the current native Jev candidate universe
frozenProtocol.dataFeed: Raw IEX-only historical bars; original arrival/publication and broker fills not observed
frozenProtocol.chronology: January precedes publication of the February research note; September was already examined. This extended check is a retrospective falsification diagnostic and is not an untouched or prospective holdout.
frozenProtocol.actualFeesAndOperatingCosts: UNKNOWN; all bps are declared scenarios

discoveryFrozenProtocol.adaptation: Long-only; one whole-share position; 20 percent gross exposure; 15-minute holding cap; entry-only pullback; immediate modelled protective exits; no volatility leverage or delayed stops
discoveryFrozenProtocol.atrDefinition: Wilder daily true-range average from strictly prior raw IEX daily bars; seeded with first 14 July observations; daily bars include provider session definition
discoveryFrozenProtocol.entryPullback: A negative completed five-minute close-to-close return while price remains above the breakout band; pending entry expires after 15 minutes or a close at/below the band
discoveryFrozenProtocol.sessionOpenProxy: First regular-session IEX five-minute bar open, not official auction price
discoveryFrozenProtocol.breakoutStop: Session opening proxy; protective trigger is the larger of this proxy and the 50bp price stop; bar gaps fill at the open and intrabar crossings at the trigger with declared costs
discoveryFrozenProtocol.fillProxy: Next eligible five-minute bar open after the completed signal bar, with adverse one-way cost; zero extra-bar lag has unknown publication/transport latency and is not a verified fill
discoveryFrozenProtocol.actualFeesAndOperatingCosts: UNKNOWN; scenario cost is not broker-calibrated and excludes operating costs
discoveryFrozenProtocol.barCoverageGate: Require every expected regular-session bar for every retained symbol-session; no imputation or dropping gapped sessions
discoveryFrozenProtocol.role: Supplementary paired experiment; does not replace the required native Jev-plus-three-controls comparison

independentAccounting.verificationBoundary: Decimal trade accounting, compounded returns, monthly totals, position limits and proxy chronology; original availability, actual quotes, fills and costs remain unverified
